references.text: Joshua conquered Hazor and killed its king, since Hazor had previously been the capital of all these kingdoms
Jabin, king of Canaan who ruled in Hazor, is mentioned again during Deborah's time as an enemy of Israel
Jabin, the king of Hazor, was finally defeated by the Israelites under Deborah and Barak
The list of conquered kings includes the kings of Madon and Hazor who were mentioned in the coalition
Hazor is mentioned as one of the cities assigned to the tribe of Naphtali
Hazor is mentioned as one of the cities Solomon built up with forced labor
